CFML Language Reference: Functions

QueryAddRow

Adds one or more empty rows to the end of a query. Fill them with QuerySetCell.

Category

Query functions

Syntax

QueryAddRow(query [, number ])

Parameters

query
A query, from QueryNew or CFQUERY.
number
How many rows to add. The default is 1.

Returns

The total number of rows in the query after the addition.

Usage

The usual pattern is to add one row, then call QuerySetCell without a row number, which fills the last row. Adding rows to a query returned by CFQUERY changes only the copy in memory, never the database.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Team = QueryNew("Name, Role")>
<CFLOOP LIST="Ann:Coder,Bob:Tester,Cy:Pizza runner" INDEX="Pair">
  <CFSET Rows = QueryAddRow(Team)>
  <CFSET Temp = QuerySetCell(Team, "Name", ListFirst(Pair, ":"))>
  <CFSET Temp = QuerySetCell(Team, "Role", ListLast(Pair, ":"))>
</CFLOOP>
<CFOUTPUT><P>The query has #Rows# rows (RecordCount = #Team.RecordCount#).</P></CFOUTPUT>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<CFOUTPUT QUERY="Team">
<TR><TD>#CurrentRow#</TD><TD>#Name#</TD><TD>#Role#</TD></TR>
</CFOUTPUT>
</TABLE>

See also

QueryNew, QuerySetCell, QueryAddColumn
